projects.title: Travel Recommendation
projects.description:
We created an expert system that helps students decide on their vacation location during breaks when they live in Berlin, Germany. Having two members of the group living in Berlin, we understand the headache of having to choose one among Schengen countries, and research more on the countries that are visa-free specifically to our citizenship.

Furthermore, the COVID situations among countries are also very different and we want to take this into account without having to look up numbers for every single country.

Our expert system sets out to resolves this problem.

Askables overview (8 askables):
The first two questions are (1) "Are you currently having any COVID-19 symptomps?", and (2) "Have you vaccinated/ recovered?". If the user answer either Yes to question (1) or No to question(2), the expert system would immediately tell the user to stay home.
If they pass the basic requirements, we ask users on their preference of (3) region, (4) vibe, (5) citizenship, (6,7)COVID situation (death rate and infection rate), (8) PCR test requirement. Using this input, we search through our knowledge base to filter for countries that fits these requirements.
